song.name: Haunting Life
song.plot: Anya's final internal monologue as she begins her eternal watch — the Warden's vigil in the deepest Void.
song.analysis: Anya's final internal monologue as she begins her eternal watch. Full structure restored (kept song); light anchors grafted: the Void, the Rift, the Warden's destiny.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: I live in a world of shadows Where nothing is what it seems I live in a world of pain Where happiness is just a dream
section.reworked: I live in a world of shadows Where nothing is what it seems I live in a world of pain Where happiness is just a dream

section.name: Pre-chorus
section.original: But I can't escape from this nightmare That haunts me every day and night I can't escape from this hell That burns me with its fire and light
section.reworked: But I can't escape from this nightmare That haunts me every day and night I can't escape from the Void That burns me with its fire and light

section.name: Chorus
section.original: This is my haunting life This is my cursed fate This is my wasted time This is my endless wait
section.reworked: This is my haunting life This is my cursed fate This is my wasted time This is my endless wait

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: I see the ghosts of my past That remind me of my sins I see the demons of my mind That feed on my fears and doubts
